name: World Championship
epitaph: fWo's World Championship: the earliest reign served here begins on 24 April 1998, held by Jim Dudley. The fed's own record carries 66 reigns on it; 50 of them, across 24 different champions, are served here so far. The longest of those is Erik Kelly's, 187 days from 27 April 2002. Five of them ended outside a match (stripped, vacated).

name: International Championship

The fed's own record carries 24 reigns on it; 24 of them, across 15 different champions, are served here so far. The longest of those is Eron the Relentless's, 94 days from 31 October 1999. One of them ended outside a match (retired).

name: Internet Championship
epitaph: fWo's Internet Championship: the earliest reign served here begins on 8 May 1998, held by Austin Davis. Five of them ended outside a match (retired, stripped, vacated). The Flying Frenchie held it at the end of the surviving record.
